sections.heading: A more flexible way to get senior marketing leadership.

items.q: Do you only work with UK clients?
items.a: No. Commview is based in Manchester and works primarily with B2B businesses, but the model can support international businesses and multi-market work. Our experience includes GTM and digital programmes across the UK, Europe and wider international markets, so geography does not need to dictate the engagement.

items.q: Do you meet clients in person?
items.a: Yes, where it improves the work. Workshops, leadership decisions and periods of embedded delivery can benefit from being in the room. Other work is usually faster remotely. We agree the working model around the engagement rather than requiring clients to buy a fixed number of office days.

items.q: Do I need to be based in London to hire a fractional CMO?
items.a: No. Commview is Manchester-based and can work with businesses across the UK. Location matters far less than access to the right stakeholders, data and decisions. Where in-person work is useful, we agree when and where it will make the biggest difference.
